description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a national fried-chicken chain with a location in Fort St. John on Alaska Road South, a major artery for cyclists and travellers heading toward or returning from Alaska Highway country. The restaurant features a drive-through as well as dine-in and takeout options, making it a convenient calorie stop on a long northern BC touring route.
